name: Template Whisperer
description: Formalised way to declare and suggest page templates.
project_description: Provides a formalized way to declare and suggest page templates using "Template Whisperer". Instead of writing a bespoke hook_theme_suggestions_HOOK_alter() per project, an editor picks a named suggestion from a field on the entity, and the module injects the matching Twig theme suggestion (for example node--article--news_list.html.twig or page--node--news_list.html.twig) so the theme can provide an alternate template. Suggestions are lightweight configuration entities (a human name plus a machine-name suggestion). The module ships a dedicated field type/widget/formatter, a block visibility Condition plugin keyed on the chosen suggestion, full Token integration (including a chained suggestion:lookup token that resolves to the first entity using a suggestion, useful for content-driven Pathauto patterns), a Twig function, and a usage-tracking table. Sponsored by Antistatique.
